text:
Marta (PM): Quick sync — need a curation SLA/runbook for new models entering the catalog. Goal: reduce surprises for customers and ops. Can we draft criteria + deprecation playbook today?

Evan Chen: +1. High level: entry criteria, perf benchmarks, security scan, privacy review, pinned version policy, migration window.

Priya Patel: suggest mandatory perf vs. baseline (latency p50/p95, throughput), quality evals (win-rate on held prompts), cost estimate.

Leila Gomez: add inference artifact checks: tokenizer compatibility, kv-cache correctness, reproducible outputs on small tests.

Todd (Eng): also need rollout phases: internal dogfood -> opt-in beta customers -> gradual rollout -> full publish. Automation in console to toggle pinning.

Marta (PM): timeline proposal: 2 weeks to create checklist + dashboard; 4 weeks to implement console flags + docs.

Evan Chen: deprecation policy proposal: 90 days notice + automated migration suggestions (closest compatible model) + 'pin until end-of-life' for paying customers.

Priya Patel: customers should be able to pin a model major.minor. Policy: pin blocks auto-update, but we surface security patches.

Leila Gomez: metrics to track post-launch: error rate, hallucination regression (via eval set), latency regressions, cost per 1k tokens.

Todd (Eng): ops runbook for rollback: 1) detect regression via alerts, 2) auto-fallback to previous pinned variant, 3) notify customers + open incident.

Marta (PM): ok. Can someone draft the runbook sections? Assign: Evan - entry criteria + benchmarks; Priya - eval/quality + customer communication; Leila - infra/tests + pin semantics; Todd - rollout automation + rollback playbook.

Evan Chen: I'm on it. I'll post a PR with proposed checklist tonight.

Priya Patel: will draft the customer-facing migration email templates. include opt-in link.

Leila Gomez: I'll add automated pre-flight tests and a sample `curl` smoke test. snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rcv1-v2","prompt":"Hello"}'
```

Todd (Eng): I'll stub the console flags. question: do we allow pinning per-route or org-wide?

Marta (PM): prefer per-org + per-route override. make UX simple.

catalog-bot: New draft checklist PR opened by Evan — <https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/482> (auto).

Priya Patel: ack. We'll review PR tomorrow 10am PT.

Leila Gomez: can we include a migration metric: % of traffic migrated per week? default target 25%/week.

Evan Chen: sounds reasonable.

Marta (PM): final ask: include launch criteria: all checks green, 1 customer beta + no critical regressions for 7 days, docs + migration guide published.

Todd (Eng): noted.

Priya Patel: also flag legal/data residency if model training includes non-compliant data.

Marta (PM): thanks all. I'll compile and update OKRs. :sparkles:
